component.name: Koalino
component.summary: Offline meeting notes: record, transcribe, summarize

description.p: Koalino records meetings and transcribes them on your own devices, with speaker names, notes, photos and files. Your devices sync with each other directly, encrypted, without a server. Summaries and chat can use an AI connection you choose, or your own Claude or ChatGPT account.
Permanent application ID, the Koalino icon, and encrypted backups of all data on Android. Data from the first preview moves to the new folder on first start.
